inputFiles.beam.dat:
RNDSEED      	89736501     ! Random seed
JPART0       	2            ! Incident particle type
TMAX0      	58.4 0.48       ! Incident energy and energy spread; both in (MeV/nucl)
TCUT0       0 58.6  ! energy cutoffs [MeV]
NSTAT       1000000    0       ! NSTAT, Step of saving
STRAGG          2            ! Straggling: 0-Off 1-Gauss, 2-Vavilov
MSCAT           2            ! Mult. scatt 0-Off 1-Gauss, 2-Moliere
NUCRE           1            ! Nucl.Reac. switcher: 1-ON, 0-OFF
! no beam modulator
BEAMPOS         0 0 -51 ! Position of the beam
BEAMDIR         0.0 0.0 ! Direction of the beam
BEAMSIGMA       0 0  ! Beam extension
! no BEAMSAD value
DELTAE          0.002   ! relative mean energy loss per transportation step
inputFiles.detect.dat:
Geometry Cyl
    Name NarrowZCylinder
    R 0 3 1
    Z -50 10 400

Geometry Mesh
    Name YZ_Mesh
    X -0.5 0.5 1
    Y -45 45 900
    Z -60 20 800

Geometry Cyl
    Name BeforeTarget
    R 0 5 1
    Z -45.05 -44.95 1

Geometry Cyl
    Name Isocenter
    R 0 5 1
    Z -0.05 0.05 1

Geometry Cyl
    Name RadialProfileIsocenter
    R 0 30 300
    Z -0.05 0.05 1

Filter
    Name Protons
    Z == 1
    A == 1
Filter
    Name Primaries
    Z == 1
    A == 1
    GEN == 0
Filter
    Name Secondary_protons
    Z == 1
    A == 1
    GEN >= 1
Settings
    Name Dose
    Medium 3
Settings
    Name DoseToWater
    Medium 3
Output
    Filename yz_profile.bdo
    Geo YZ_Mesh
    Quantity Fluence Protons 

Output
    Filename z_profile.bdo
    Geo NarrowZCylinder
    Quantity Fluence Protons 
    Quantity AvgEnergy Primaries 
    Quantity Dose  Dose

Output
    Filename Before_Scatterer.bdo
    Geo BeforeTarget
    Quantity AvgEnergy Primaries 
    Quantity AvgEnergy Protons 
    Quantity AvgEnergy Secondary_protons 
    Quantity Fluence Protons 
    Diff1 55 60 500 
    Diff1Type E

Output
    Filename At_isocenter.bdo
    Geo Isocenter
    Quantity AvgEnergy Primaries 
    Quantity AvgEnergy Protons 
    Quantity AvgEnergy Secondary_protons 
    Quantity Fluence Protons 
    Diff1 0 25 125 
    Diff1Type E

Output
    Filename Radial_profile_isocenter.bdo
    Geo RadialProfileIsocenter
    Quantity Fluence Protons 
    Quantity Dose  DoseToWater
    Quantity AvgEnergy Protons
